svg.title: Timing diagram: from enrolment to breach and repair
svg.text: Timing: agent roll-out, quote, bind, then a breach and its repair (one control: EDR)
time (days since onboarding; the demo compresses this with fast-forward)
ONLINE (reports every tick; heartbeat keeps it ≤ 6 h)
bound premium, fixed: unchanged through the breach
• A fleet result reaches the platform within one link-worker pass (≤ 30 s) of the report that changed it, or on the 15-minute heartbeat.
• d10: one failing host out of four puts the fleet below 95 %, so CTRL-EDR is NOT_WORKING and the warranty starts its 7-day grace.
• d17: still failing, so BREACHED: the configured coverage consequence applies (incident-response deductible doubled).
• d19: the next passing roll-up moves BREACHED → REMEDIATED → MET at once. The premium line never moves after bind.
Figure B17. Timing diagram (value-lifeline form). Each row is one lifeline; a change of band is a state change at that time.
